description: A port operations dashboard for the duty dispatcher of Westhaven, a fictional container port: an orbitable 3D harbour, berth planning with drag-to-assign, conflict checks and an optimiser, a container explorer with a 3D inspection scanner, river traffic with crew chat, and port security. Built with MVVM (CommunityToolkit.Mvvm partial properties and x:Bind), Uno Navigation, the Uno Toolkit and the Simple theme in Light and Dark, with SkiaSharp scenes on SKCanvasElement. Every figure is in memory, so it runs with no backend.

showcase.summary: A port dispatcher's evening shift in one dashboard: a live 3D harbour, berth planning, container inspection and river traffic.
goals: A dense operations dashboard that reflows from phone to wide desktop through one utu:ResponsiveLayout (600, 1000, 1280, 1600)
MVVM with CommunityToolkit.Mvvm partial properties and x:Bind over one observable store, with the view models that hold logic tested without the UI
SkiaSharp scenes on SKCanvasElement: an orbitable 3D harbour, the shift's timeline lanes and a live tide chart
Uno Navigation with a route per section and Security's tabs as nested routes
Light and Dark through ThemeResource tokens, with the theme and reduced-motion choices kept across launches
Keyboard paths beside the pointer: Move to berth next to the drag, arrow keys on the harbour, the yard map and the bay view
